user.title: Utility Meter Reader
user.description: Configure the RTL-SDR receiver used to decode utility meter transmissions. Only one RTL-SDR dongle is supported per Home Assistant instance.

meters.title: Per-Meter Display Scale
meters.description: For each meter that has reported in, set the multiplier to convert its raw ERT count to a real-world unit (e.g. 1 for kWh, 0.01 for CCF if the meter reports in cubic feet) and label the unit. Fields are named meter_<id>_multiplier / meter_<id>_unit.
